results.name: Canonical 71 equipment records, 256 tier variants, categories, sources and IDs
Acquisition does not classify random rewards as guaranteed; 70 item-specific routes
Tier capacity: no fictional slots, exact standard unlocks and x-MOD2 capacities
Class, technology, individual support and quality gates all apply
Most iconics lack mod slots; explicit Yasha and x-MOD2 exceptions remain
Scopes, silencers and fixed factory sights are distinguished
Throwable and melee restrictions are not confused with ranged mods
One Chimera core per configuration; alternative builds are independent
Unknown references, unknown tier capacities and unavailable mod tiers never validate
Build creation and configuration never mutate weapon data or stats
Export/import retains long notes, tags, favorite and IDs with explicit schema
Duplicate IDs import as copies without overwriting existing or same-file duplicates
Malformed structures, future schemas and prototype-pollution keys are rejected safely
Missing/stale references and orphan slots survive import with explicit review flags
Approved base styling and weapon/artifact source hashes remain unchanged
